watch.summary: A streamer praises a Valorant team right as they get instantly wiped out in a professional match.

beats.what: Opposing team LOUD rapidly kills three 100 Thieves players.
Creator reacts in disbelief at the sudden wipe.
The last surviving 100T player is eliminated to lose the round.
Creator screams and jumps out of his chair in shock.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: All of them on that team are good, I'm not gonna lie guys.
watch.why: The immediate contradiction between the creator praising a team and them instantly dying creates great comedic timing. His energetic, physical reaction to the jinx enhances the moment.
